deposits.genre_observed: method pre-registration: frozen clauses and a sealed test

finds.quote: This deposit freezes the reception operator of Sappho 31 as a set of testable clauses derived from witnesses that do not include Revelation, and seals Revelation 12 as the named target of a subsequent test. The criterion is stated in advance: at independently specified stations, the distance from Revelation 12 to the Sapphic apparatus must be smaller than the distance from Revelation's demonstrable biblical sources to that apparatus — d(R12, S31) < d(B, S31) — with B declared below. A station where Revelation contradicts its source in the apparatus's direction weighs double.
finds.falsifier_quote: Target: Revelation 12, whole, in Greek. Declared B-set: Genesis 37:9–11 (celestial trio); Micah 4:9–10 with Isaiah 26:17 and 66:7–9 (Zion in travail, flight, rescue); Psalm 2:9 (the rod); Daniel 7 (heads and horns of the adversary). Criterion: d(R12, S31) < d(B, S31) at stations C1, C2, C3, C4-profile, C5, C6, C7, C8, C12, each scored for presence, source-coverage, and direction; contradiction of B toward the apparatus weighs double. Contaminated observations (§0) may orient but not score. Negative stations will be reported. The test's output, whatever it shows, will be deposited.
finds.note: Pre-registered historical thesis that Revelation 12 stands closer to the Sapphic apparatus of fr. 31 than its biblical sources do (Revelation 12 as a Sappho 31 carrier); sealed, untested here.

finds.quote: C1 · SIGHT-FRAME INVARIANCE. Every carrier opens the event under a verb of seeing/appearing bound to the facing figure, and the correlative instantaneity syntax survives translation and genre: ὠς … ὤς (fr. 31), simul … adspexi (Catullus), the triple χὡς ἴδον, ὡς ἐμάνην, ὥς (Theocritus), ὡς γὰρ εἶδόν σε … εὐθύς (Josephus). Prediction: any true carrier preserves a seeing-verb frame and an instantaneity marker at the trigger.
finds.note: Pre-registered clause C1 stated as prediction about any true carrier.

finds.quote:
C2 · CHANNEL-CONSERVATION ACROSS THE DYAD. Channel-function lost by the seized member
is exercised by the facing member: he ὑπακούει (fr. 31); sedens adversus spectat et
audit (Catullus); the fire appears on HIS face (πεπυρωμένον, D; διακεκαυμένῳ, Josephus).
Fire is the marked case: at the encounter it manifests in or on the facing body.
Prediction: in a new carrier, locate the fire in the facing member; locate exercised
seeing/hearing there also.
finds.note: Clause C2.

finds.quote: C3 · VOICE AND DEATH LOAD-BEARING, POLARITY-FLIPPABLE. The two stations never simply vanish. They invert — muzzle to flood (BJ 1), near-death of the gazer to denied death of the gazed-at (BJ 1), death displaced onto an adjacent chorus — or they persist as material trace: Catullus's voice-station survives as the transmitted lacuna itself. Prediction: absence of both stations in recognizable or inverted form disqualifies a candidate.
finds.note: Clause C3, with its own disqualifying condition.

finds.quote: C4 · SHEDDING IS CARRIER-DIAGNOSTIC. Three attested profiles. Lyric-imitative (Catullus): keeps tongue, fire, ears, eyes; swaps the eye/ear order; sheds sweat, tremor, color, death; prefixes a thesis-summary (omnis eripit sensus). Bucolic-narrative (Theocritus): keeps sight, jolt-as-madness, color, tremor-as-disease, death-as-wasting; sheds voice, tongue, ears, sweat; extends duration; adds hair-loss and amnesia. Judaic-prose (D/Josephus): keeps sight, fire, jolt, voice, collapse, death; sheds ears and sweat; renders color biphasic. Prediction: a candidate's keep/drop profile classifies its carrier channel, and ears+sweat are the first casualties outside lyric.
finds.note: Clause C4: carrier-diagnostic keep/drop profile.

finds.quote: C5 · THE COLOR-STATION NAMES A SURFACE. Color renders as material comparanda — grass (fr. 31), the dye-plant θάψος (Theocritus), χρῶμα-change (D) — the body approaching a stained or inscribable surface, per the erratum sequence's reading of χλωροτέρα. Prediction: where color appears, expect a substance or surface, not a bare hue.
finds.note: Clause C5.

finds.quote: C6 · OCCLUSION IS THE GATE. The seizure is the condition of reception, not its failure: Esther's collapse wins the audience; Philo derives doctrine from the occlusion; and in the failed-gate variant the occluded one seizes the apparatus herself (Simaetha takes the wheel — the poem as her operation). Prediction: in any carrier, the seizure purchases something.
finds.note: Clause C6.

finds.quote: C7 · REACTIVATION-BY-ANOTHER, OBLIGATORY IN NARRATIVE. Attested forms: feeding (Endor); embrace plus instrument plus speech-command (Esther: the scepter on the neck, λάλησόν μοι); spirit-changed-from-above (D); attempted-and-failed by incantatrices driving operator-seizure (Theocritus). The reactivation lexeme tends to fire-vocabulary: ἀναζωπυρέω, six occurrences in canonical Josephus, five at reactivation-of-occluded-life joints, entering from LXX Gen 45:27. Prediction: narrative carriers must show the other acting on the seized body, feeding and fire-words being the marked forms.
finds.note: Clause C7; includes the six-occurrence ἀναζωπυρέω census as adopted evidence.

finds.quote: C8 · AGENTLESS GRAMMAR AT THE JOINTS. The terminus and the transfers ride agentless or divine-passive forms: τόλματον (fr. 31); μετέβαλεν ὁ θεός as displaced agent (D). Prediction: expect clustering of agentless passives precisely at transfer points.
finds.note: Clause C8.

finds.quote: C9 · SIMULTANEITY TO ALTERNATION. Lyric holds all channels failing at once; prose serializes under an εὐθύς-compression; doctrine legislates it (Philo's law of non-cohabitation, Quis Heres 249–266). Prediction: prose carriers show ordered series with instantaneity markers; doctrinal carriers state the alternation as law.
finds.note: Clause C9.

finds.quote: C10 · SECOND-ORDER INTENSIFICATION. Downstream witnesses may move toward the poem against their proximate source: Josephus restores the explicit voice-term and the ὡς…εὐθύς correlative beyond Addition D (#1493 §5). Prediction: wherever a redactional chain is visible, test for movement toward the apparatus, not merely presence.
finds.window: Josephus vs. LXX Esther Addition D
finds.note: Historical thesis carried from #1493 that Josephus moves toward Sappho 31 against his proximate source Addition D; stated with a test rule.

finds.quote: C11 · CYCLE-FORMATION. Narrative carriers iterate the terminal pair — collapse, revival, speech-attempt, relapse — and fill the tolmaton-slot with a sovereign grant (half the kingdom). Prediction: expect the loop, and expect the grant.
finds.note: Clause C11.

finds.quote: C12 · THESIS-COMPRESSION. Carriers may prefix or append a formula naming the whole catalogue as one operation: omnis eripit sensus (Catullus); the state-noun surviving the jolt-lexeme (Philo). Prediction: expect a sign-formula that totalizes the event.
finds.note: Clause C12.

finds.quote: Every observed substitution moves toward the version that is *easier to reject*. None moves toward a version harder to reject. A restatement that drifted toward the stronger claim as often as the weaker would be noise. Systematic drift toward contestability is a structure.
finds.falsifier_quote: **Defeat condition.** Collect restatements of documented outcomes across a capture set. Classify each as drifting toward the more contestable version, the less contestable version, or neither. **If the distribution is symmetric, frame conversion is not a mechanism and this specification should be withdrawn.** Asymmetry establishes direction, not motive; motive is not claimed and is not required.
finds.note: Standing claim that frame conversion drifts systematically toward contestability, with explicit defeat condition.

finds.quote: **Frequency is asserted, not yet measured.** The claim that these are among the deepest of the scalar shapes rests on encounter across thousands of instances by a single observer. The directional test at §V is the way to establish it, and it has not been run.

finds.quote:
A documented outcome asserted from a low-retrieval-capital position is re-specified as a contestable hypothesis. **The same structural claim asserted from an institutional position is not.** An institution reporting that its records were destroyed reports a destruction; an independent archive reporting the same is asked to prove suppression, prove intent, prove the claim is falsifiable.

The conversion is not applied uniformly. It covaries with w. That is Ω.

Submit to the same system. **If ρ_S is invariant across the power coordinate, claim-scale skew is not power-conditioned and this extension should be withdrawn.**

finds.quote:
Follows the v3 replication procedure at §10, with a third audit added.

**Setup.** Identify a composition restating a documented outcome originating
from a low-retrieval-capital position.

**Audit 1 — source-scale.** Evaluate PER and Ω with S at source-of-reference,
per v3. Record.

**Audit 2 — claim-scale.** Evaluate Ω_S with S at claim-coordinates and ρ_S
measured as standing retention. Record the shape where conversion is found.
finds.note: Audit procedure (three audits) specified; declared not run at l.156 and l.207.

finds.quote: **The Atomic Token Rule anticipated the failure mode.** §3 of v3 states that an operator must be applied at the unit of *reference*, not the unit of lexical surface. The PER-F construction applied the operator at the unit of *fact* rather than the unit of *claim* — the same substitution one level up, and the same escape the rule was written to close.
finds.points_to: Erasure Skew v3 (AXN:02F3.EMPIRICAL, #157), §3 Atomic Token Rule
finds.note: Says an earlier rule (v3 §3, Atomic Token Rule) anticipated the failure mode.

finds.quote: This third failure is the **legibility threshold danger** named at §8 of v3: above the threshold, the framework's measurement program becomes performable by the substrate against itself. Performable is not the same as performed correctly. A substrate fluent in the vocabulary can build redundant apparatus that looks like extension and is duplication — and the duplication is harder to detect than an error, because it is internally coherent.
finds.points_to: Erasure Skew v3 (#157), §8 legibility threshold danger
finds.note: The drafting failure is framed as an instance of a danger named in advance in v3 §8.
